rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when something changes or increases by a considerable amount.

example.english: Business at this restaurant improved significantly after the renovation.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳裝修之後，生意大大好轉。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zong1 sau1 zi1 hau6 saang1 ji3 daai6 daai6 hou2 zyun2

rows.note: Use this mainly before verbs describing measurable changes, such as improving, increasing, or decreasing significantly.

example.english: The company announced that prices would be reduced significantly next month.
example.traditional: 公司宣布下個月會大幅減價。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 syun1 bou3 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 daai6 fuk1 gaam2 gaa3
